veto_rules.rule: Never chase highs; only buy on pullbacks.
veto_rules.rationale: High expected returns and risk-reward come from buying during pullbacks into high-value zones, not from chasing momentum peaks.

veto_rules.rule: Avoid 'all-in' compound gambling and short-term speculative 'meme-like' long holds.
veto_rules.rationale: Binary, all-or-nothing bets expose traders to extreme ruin risks where a single mistake erases all gains, which is unsuitable for sustainable investing.

falsifiability_rules.falsifier: If the descending slope fails to slow down despite accelerating drop speeds and volume expansion.
